prompts.initial: Create one production sprite atlas with THREE separate menacing DARK FANTASY ENEMIES, transparent background. Reference controls tone: tall lean cursed warriors with long limbs and small heads, NOT chibi, NOT cute, NOT cartoon toys. Exactly3 equal-width cells in one row, all complete bodies and feet aligned. Left: gaunt faceless corrupted archer in ragged indigo cloak, long bow, narrow magenta fissure in hood. Center: lean black-armored executioner with long magenta glaive, pointed helmet, shredded crimson tabard. Right: Bloom Warden miniboss, tall ivory angular armor, antler-like helmet, rose-white spear, ominous pink petal halo behind shoulders, dark magenta corruption cracks. Each figure approximately6 heads tall, smallest possible head, no giant eyes, no round baby proportions. Game-ready crisp pixel art at about96px body height, readable oblique2.5D view like dark fantasy action RPG. Full body, no ground, no shadows, no labels/text/dividers/UI, no background. Restrained midnight blue and charcoal, muted rose highlights, bright magenta only weapon cores/cracks. Threatening silhouette, sharp edges, minimal pixel shading and convincing small volume. Keep all three characters widely separated in their own equal cells. Existing white-headed player is NOT to be redesigned.
